description: Java source code for InternalProgressiveLoanApiResource class, providing internal API endpoints for managing progressive loan interest schedules, including fetching and updating models, with emphasis on non-production use.

classes.name: InternalProgressiveLoanApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource for internal management of progressive loan interest schedules, including fetching and updating models, intended for testing purposes.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initialization method that logs a warning indicating this API should not be used in production.

methods.name: fetchModel
methods.description: Fetches the ProgressiveLoanInterestScheduleModel for a given loan ID, only if the loan has a progressive schedule.

methods.name: reprocessTransactionsAndGetModel
methods.description: Reprocesses non-reversed transactions for a loan and returns the updated interest schedule model.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Reprocesses transactions and updates the interest schedule model for a given loan ID.
